statement: A restarted seed or joiner preserves canonical poison-row recovery metadata across the SQL replay-summary boundary and publishes transaction_recovery_incomplete with decisionDimension=commit_mode and the canonical route source through the startup runtime handoff owner before any generic admission classification; a fail-closed controlled live vehicle proves at least two fixed samples against at least two source-reverted samples.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The SQL recovery replay wrapper must preserve the canonical errorCode and decisionDimension when it returns a failed replay summary. StartupRuntimeHandoffOwner remains the single owner that converts that summary into a failed typed handoff outcome and retains the summary for diagnostics.

The live vehicle must fail when the poisoned row is not observed, recovery is not engaged, no failed handoff sample is captured, the typed outcome is absent, decisionDimension is not commit_mode, routeSource is absent, or generic nodeAdmissionBlocked masks the causal outcome.

Run at least two clean fixed samples and two clean source-reverted samples with identical node count, workload, poison row, restart schedule, fingerprint capture, and fail-closed assertions. Fixed samples must pass with typed owner evidence; reverted samples must fail for the named missing contract.

Do not add a parallel replay owner or patch seed-contact/bootstrap routing. Recovery activation and failed-summary classification remain inside the existing startup runtime handoff owner, with routeSource supplied by the existing seed/join composition.
Produce a fresh scenario-harness report before each attempt commit, and preserve the predecessor live failure as evidence for the summary-boundary diagnosis.
